about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: My path in technology began with cybersecurity and concern for people who lose control of their accounts or information. That concern was one of the reasons that led me to found Kexory.
about.paragraph2: Today, my interests go beyond a single discipline: I want to learn, build products, and explore how software, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence can solve real problems.
about.paragraph3: I take part in different parts of the process, from development and strategy to communication and content creation. I'm building experience one project at a time, with curiosity, judgment, and responsibility.

principles.title: Technology should open possibilities, not create new barriers.
principles.body: I believe people should be able to benefit from useful, accessible, and secure technology. Trust, privacy, and human needs should be part of how we design and build products.
